doc.title: Pololu item #2831, 5V, 1A Step-Down Voltage Regulator D24V10F5, section Connections
doc.pinNumbering: The product page names five connections (PG, SHDN, VIN, GND, VOUT) without numbers; they are numbered 1-5 in the order the Connections section lists them.
doc.notes: SHDN has a built-in 100 kOhm pull-up to VIN and may be left unconnected; PG is an open-drain output. Input 5.1-36 V, output fixed 5 V.
